caseName: Howell & Howell, Inc. v. Local Union No. 118, International Brotherhood of Painters & Allied Trades
caseNameFull: Howell & Howell, Inc. v. Local Union No. 118, International Brotherhood of Painters & Allied Trades

opinions.text:
Application for injunction pending appeal, addressed to Justice Stevens and referred to the Court, denied.

Justice Rehnquist took no part in the consideration or decision of this application.
